answer:
Create a 2D dam-break simulation case directory for OpenFOAM using the interFoam VOF solver.
The physical domain is a rectangle 0.4 m long in x and 0.1 m high in y, extruded one cell in z to form a 2D slice.
The mesh uses a single hex block with 100 cells in x, 100 cells in y, and 1 cell in z, with uniform grading (1 1 1).
The z-dimension spans from 0 to a small delta (e.g. 0.01 m); the exact thickness is irrelevant.
The two z-faces of the block are designated as the "frontAndBack" patch with type "empty".
The four remaining faces are: bottom wall, left wall, right wall, and top open boundary.
In system/controlDict set application to interFoam.
In 0/alpha.water initialize the field as uniform 0 (air everywhere).
Use setFields with a boxes entry ( (0 0 -1) (0.1 0.1 1) ) to set alpha.water = 1 inside the water column.
The water column occupies the region x in [0, 0.1], y in [0, 0.1], i.e. the full left-side height of the domain.
In 0/U set no-slip fixedValue (0 0 0) on bottom, left, and right walls.
In 0/U set inletOutlet with inletValue uniform (0 0 0) and value uniform (0 0 0) on the top boundary.
In 0/U set empty for frontAndBack.
In 0/p_rgh set zeroGradient on bottom, left, and right walls.
In 0/p_rgh set totalPressure with p0 0 on the top boundary.
In 0/p_rgh set empty for frontAndBack.
In 0/alpha.water set zeroGradient on bottom, left, and right walls.
In 0/alpha.water set inletOutlet with inletValue uniform 0 and value uniform 0 on the top boundary.
In 0/alpha.water set empty for frontAndBack.
In constant/g set the gravitational acceleration vector to (0 -9.81 0).
In constant/transportProperties use standard water (rho 998, nu 1e-6) and air (rho 1, nu 1.5e-5) properties.
In constant/phaseProperties set the alpha.water phase to incompressible transport model with the water properties above.
In system/fvSchemes use MULES for alpha water with a maximum Courant number of 0.5, Euler time discretization, and second-order central differencing for gradients.
In system/fvSolution use PIMPLE with nOuterCorrectors 1, nCorrectors 3, and nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0.
In system/controlDict set startTime 0, endTime 1.0, adjustTimeStep yes, maxCo 0.5, maxAlphaCo 0.5, writeInterval 50.
In system/blockMeshDict define the frontAndBack boundary as a patch of type "empty" with no faces (faces entry is empty list), referencing the two z-oriented boundaryFaces patches.
Run blockMesh then setFields to generate the mesh and initialize the sharp free surface.
